executorch.source_note: LLM families with an executorch/examples/models/<dir> export (dir -> model_type by hand, EXECUTORCH_DIRS) plus the decoder model types optimum-executorch tests (tests/models/test_modeling_<type>.py, pinned main commit; its v0.1.0 release is a year old)

llama.cpp.source_note: @ModelBase.register names on text-model classes in conversion/*.py (the convert_hf_to_gguf.py package); runtime_archs = LLM_ARCH_NAMES in src/llama-arch.cpp

mlx-lm.source_note: file names of mlx_lm/models/*.py (helper modules dropped) plus MODEL_REMAPPING aliases

onnx.source_note: @register_tasks_manager_onnx model types whose tasks include text-generation (optimum-onnx pinned main commit; its v0.1.0 release predates most current models)

tgi.source_note: ModelType enum 'type' values; transformers_fallback = the other model types of transformers v4.51.3 MODEL_FOR_CAUSAL_LM_MAPPING_NAMES, which get_model() runs through its transformers fallback (shown as a separate tier, not counted as native; remote code through auto_map is not counted)

transformers.source_note: model_types = keys of the causal-LM / image-text-to-text / multimodal-LM mappings that are also in CONFIG_MAPPING_NAMES (auto_mappings.py plus configuration_auto.py's update); architectures = those mappings' class names

transformers.js.source_note: keys of MODEL_FOR_CAUSAL_LM / IMAGE_TEXT_TO_TEXT / MULTIMODALITY mapping names

vllm.source_note: keys of _TEXT_GENERATION_MODELS and _MULTIMODAL_MODELS; transformers_backend = the keys of _TRANSFORMERS_SUPPORTED_MODELS (vLLM runs them through its Transformers backend: shown as a separate tier, not counted as native)
